What neighbors say, season by season

4.9 average · 122 reviews Sample reviews

  • “Our house on the North Shore is from 1905 and the plaster scares most cleaners. Delia's crew knew to dust it, not scrub it, and to keep water off the heart pine.”

    Eleanor R., Chattanooga Old-house care Sample review

  • “Every April the porch turns yellow. They do the pollen clean the week after the pines finish, and the screens actually let light through again.”

    Josh M., Red Bank Spring pollen clean Sample review

  • “The guest bathroom grows mildew every August. They cleaned the grout and caulk, then showed me where to leave the fan on. It has not come back as fast.”

    Ruby H., Hixson Bathroom mildew Sample review

  • “Our cabin on Signal Mountain sits empty for weeks. They air it out, clean the kitchen and make the beds the Thursday before we drive up.”

    Grant L., Signal Mountain Mountain & weekend houses Sample review

  • “Thanksgiving with fourteen people. They came on Tuesday, made up both guest rooms and did the kitchen floor twice, once before and once after the pies.”

    Carmen E., East Ridge Holiday guest prep Sample review

  • “Every two weeks for three years. The list changes with the season: pollen in spring, mildew in summer, leaves tracked in come fall.”

    Neil P., Ooltewah Every-two-weeks cleaning Sample review
